documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Ivarsen Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
For Ivarsen Healthcare, cost synergies in FY2025 was approximately €39m (reported basis). Order backlog at Ivarsen Healthcare stood at €588.059m in FY2025 (reported basis). Ivarsen Healthcare had headline purchase price of €371.9m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Ivarsen Healthcare, employees in FY2023 was 2478. The scope of the tax warranty for Ivarsen Healthcare is understood as follows: covers periods up to completion and the following tax year. As to Ivarsen Healthcare, the deal structure is: asset purchase of the operating business only.
